content: Central Ursus, Pine Valley Retreat exterior
Hfff—huff—

Hff.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Ah, old friend, are you feeling better now?
speaker: Witte
content: Ah, old friend, are you feeling better now?

raw: [name="Witte"]  No, no, you lie down, I'm just here to see you, I'll be leaving soon after. A burdenbeast's work is never done, and the one who saddled me was myself, to boot.
speaker: Witte
content: No, no, you lie down, I'm just here to see you, I'll be leaving soon after. A burdenbeast's work is never done, and the one who saddled me was myself, to boot.

raw: [name="Witte"]  What? No, of course. To you, I'm still the same young lad you know, not the Minister of Finance.
speaker: Witte
content: What? No, of course. To you, I'm still the same young lad you know, not the Minister of Finance.

raw: [name="Witte"]  What's the point in fiddling with ranks? We're all here giving our strength to Ursus's vast land, striving for the truly honorable future Our Majesty envisions.
speaker: Witte
content: What's the point in fiddling with ranks? We're all here giving our strength to Ursus's vast land, striving for the truly honorable future Our Majesty envisions.

raw: [name="Witte"]  We're all His Majesty's people. The few who've forgotten it, still living in the violent past, will sooner or later become orphans of archaic convention.
speaker: Witte
content: We're all His Majesty's people. The few who've forgotten it, still living in the violent past, will sooner or later become orphans of archaic convention.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Sorry, it seems government business has built up some steam in me.
speaker: Witte
content: Sorry, it seems government business has built up some steam in me.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Don't worry, I can see how my colleagues and fellow strivers are strong in spirit, and I can see how the rot in the rotten eats away at themselves. We will be victorious.
speaker: Witte
content: Don't worry, I can see how my colleagues and fellow strivers are strong in spirit, and I can see how the rot in the rotten eats away at themselves. We will be victorious.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Those loudmouth nobles in the Army... they and those woodworms will very soon be dust at His Majesty's feet, and we will sweep them out of His way.
speaker: Witte
content: Those loudmouth nobles in the Army... they and those woodworms will very soon be dust at His Majesty's feet, and we will sweep them out of His way.

speaker: Witte
content: That's right.

speaker: Witte
content: —The State Council is changing.

raw: [name="Witte"]  We'll take everything Ursus, everything of His Majesty's back from those unthinking, undoing aristocrats' hands.
speaker: Witte
content: We'll take everything Ursus, everything of His Majesty's back from those unthinking, undoing aristocrats' hands.

raw: [name="Witte"]  We'll tear the olden days to shreds. Savage them. Profane them. We must open a new way for Ursus, old friend—I will do it. We all will do it. Even if it takes our whole lives.
speaker: Witte
content: We'll tear the olden days to shreds. Savage them. Profane them. We must open a new way for Ursus, old friend—I will do it. We all will do it. Even if it takes our whole lives.

speaker: Witte
content: Ursus needs change.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Today?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  The original plan was next week... but today's the best chance.
speaker: Lillia
content: The original plan was next week... but today's the best chance.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I just heard the head caretaker say. The Minister of Finance's arrival is clearly intended to rattle that spineless coward. Though the Minister was unwilling to meet him, he was at least willing to move himself.
speaker: Lillia
content: I just heard the head caretaker say. The Minister of Finance's arrival is clearly intended to rattle that spineless coward. Though the Minister was unwilling to meet him, he was at least willing to move himself.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  He's frightened. And fear will make him show openings.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: He's frightened. And fear will make him show openings.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  His guards might not have been able to arrange for this sudden meeting in time, but he had no choice except show himself before us, as hastily as possible...
speaker: Lillia
content: His guards might not have been able to arrange for this sudden meeting in time, but he had no choice except show himself before us, as hastily as possible...

raw: [name="Lillia"]  With another Ursus VIP visiting, opting to assassinate the Grand Duke is an extremely risky idea, but this place has never been empty of major players, and I can count the number of times the Grand Duke left his area alone on one hand.
speaker: Lillia
content: With another Ursus VIP visiting, opting to assassinate the Grand Duke is an extremely risky idea, but this place has never been empty of major players, and I can count the number of times the Grand Duke left his area alone on one hand.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We're still not certain enough.

speaker: Lillia
content: I'm still not certain enough.

speaker: Lillia
content: But I trust you are.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I've wanted to believe, even, that you could always do it.
speaker: Lillia
content: I've wanted to believe, even, that you could always do it.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Tell me, do you still have any misgivings?
speaker: Lillia
content: Tell me, do you still have any misgivings?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Lillia"]  I'll settle them for you, even if I—
speaker: Lillia
content: I'll settle them for you, even if I—

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Lillia.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  My greatest misgiving... is whether you'll live well, as I hope for you to.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: My greatest misgiving... is whether you'll live well, as I hope for you to.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  No matter how you'll regard what I say next, I still must recognize: in Chernobog, all those youngest, richly idealistic, most ardent scientists... all gave their lives.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No matter how you'll regard what I say next, I still must recognize: in Chernobog, all those youngest, richly idealistic, most ardent scientists... all gave their lives.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I am not willing to see them die. Lillia, I regard you in the same way right now.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I am not willing to see them die. Lillia, I regard you in the same way right now.

speaker: Lillia
content: I can't do that, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  After this is over, I'll make for Siracusa, then on to Victoria.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: After this is over, I'll make for Siracusa, then on to Victoria.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  If you come with me... and don't continue with your plans in Chernobog, then you don't have to die.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If you come with me... and don't continue with your plans in Chernobog, then you don't have to die.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I can't bear traitors stamping footprints on my husband's dried blood, not for even one second.
speaker: Lillia
content: I can't bear traitors stamping footprints on my husband's dried blood, not for even one second.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You're very selfish.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I am. So don't you forget my most selfish request of all...
speaker: Lillia
content: I am. So don't you forget my most selfish request of all...

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Look after my daughter, and if she's willing, teach her medicine.
speaker: Lillia
content: Look after my daughter, and if she's willing, teach her medicine.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  You can surely live on, Kal'tsit.
speaker: Lillia
content: You can surely live on, Kal'tsit.

speaker: Witte
content: Old friend.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Winter this year is very cold, but I trust spring will be warm as it ever was.
speaker: Witte
content: Winter this year is very cold, but I trust spring will be warm as it ever was.

raw: [name="Witte"]  I still remember the day we first met was at the beginning of spring. Attending that speech so brimming with passion, you didn't cheer, nor did you bellow.
speaker: Witte
content: I still remember the day we first met was at the beginning of spring. Attending that speech so brimming with passion, you didn't cheer, nor did you bellow.

raw: [name="Witte"]  We noticed each other when our eyes met, and of course others too.
speaker: Witte
content: We noticed each other when our eyes met, and of course others too.

raw: [name="Witte"]  No one felt any pride in the successful invasion, those cheering and revering the former Emperor's glory, unable to even see the barren land they stood on, having allowed no one else to survive.
speaker: Witte
content: No one felt any pride in the successful invasion, those cheering and revering the former Emperor's glory, unable to even see the barren land they stood on, having allowed no one else to survive.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Witte, is spring coming?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Witte, is spring coming?

raw: [name="Witte"]  I do not know, old friend. Perhaps.
speaker: Witte
content: I do not know, old friend. Perhaps.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Spring this year may come slightly early, but my Catastrophe Messenger tells me, following a fierce Catastrophe up north, it may be cooler after some days.
speaker: Witte
content: Spring this year may come slightly early, but my Catastrophe Messenger tells me, following a fierce Catastrophe up north, it may be cooler after some days.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Perhaps we may even return to winter.
speaker: Witte
content: Perhaps we may even return to winter.

raw: [Subtitle(text="None of us like winter, do we?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: None of us like winter, do we?

raw: [name="Witte"]  I don't like it either, old mate.
speaker: Witte
content: I don't like it either, old mate.

raw: [name="Witte"]  But you did warn me, perhaps I should give up the bottle... I shouldn't be weathering winter with drink. All it does is numb. Drunkenness might get me frostbitten.
speaker: Witte
content: But you did warn me, perhaps I should give up the bottle... I shouldn't be weathering winter with drink. All it does is numb. Drunkenness might get me frostbitten.

raw: [name="Witte"]  But winter won't last too long.
speaker: Witte
content: But winter won't last too long.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Just the fallout of a calamity.
speaker: Witte
content: Just the fallout of a calamity.

speaker: Lillia
content: This is...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  An eternal rest. The most secure method, completely effective, and not so fast-acting it gives us nowhere to run.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: An eternal rest. The most secure method, completely effective, and not so fast-acting it gives us nowhere to run.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Have you fully prepared our retreat?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Have you fully prepared our retreat?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  From the first day we arrived, I'd already finished preparing everything.
speaker: Lillia
content: From the first day we arrived, I'd already finished preparing everything.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Perhaps we won't have much time.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Perhaps we won't have much time.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  I understand that, but if we just do it like we practiced, we should have plenty of...
speaker: Lillia
content: I understand that, but if we just do it like we practiced, we should have plenty of...

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  We've taken this sanatorium as far too simple a place.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We've taken this sanatorium as far too simple a place.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Your plan doesn't need to change. Leave everything afterwards for me to handle.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Your plan doesn't need to change. Leave everything afterwards for me to handle.

speaker: Lillia
content: What did you find out?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Mon3tr discovered traces of the enemy while hibernating. Have you heard of the Grand Duke having dealings with other powers of Ursus, or not?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mon3tr discovered traces of the enemy while hibernating. Have you heard of the Grand Duke having dealings with other powers of Ursus, or not?

raw: [name="Lillia"]  No, he's been content here all this time.
speaker: Lillia
content: No, he's been content here all this time.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Mon3tr... is that that pet of yours? What did it see? Some Ursus folk legend?
speaker: Lillia
content: Mon3tr... is that that pet of yours? What did it see? Some Ursus folk legend?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I cannot realistically tell you the facts. That would only shrink our chances of survival to the minimum.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I cannot realistically tell you the facts. That would only shrink our chances of survival to the minimum.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Mm... Ursus has many, many means...
speaker: Lillia
content: Mm... Ursus has many, many means...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Fear becomes a lure. Investigating this will only serve to affect your judgment. Trust me.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Fear becomes a lure. Investigating this will only serve to affect your judgment. Trust me.

speaker: Lillia
content: Hm.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Alright. It's about time now.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  See the blonde Feline carrying a bag—he's the Grand Duke's private doctor.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: See the blonde Feline carrying a bag—he's the Grand Duke's private doctor.

speaker: Lillia
content: I know.

raw: [name="Witte"]  What can a Grand Duke accomplish?
speaker: Witte
content: What can a Grand Duke accomplish?

raw: [name="Witte"]  Look at these fellows stuck in their old ways... Of course, the moment that half-blinded governor knelt in front of His Majesty, he ceased to be any more of a threat.
speaker: Witte
content: Look at these fellows stuck in their old ways... Of course, the moment that half-blinded governor knelt in front of His Majesty, he ceased to be any more of a threat.

raw: [name="Witte"]  He's very smart, choosing when it suited to save his own skin. Nothing like some people... putting up last stands for their own selfish gains, even squandering what little live power Ursus had left to deal with the aftermath of the rebellions.
speaker: Witte
content: He's very smart, choosing when it suited to save his own skin. Nothing like some people... putting up last stands for their own selfish gains, even squandering what little live power Ursus had left to deal with the aftermath of the rebellions.

raw: [name="Witte"]  It grieves me so... Though I'm no military leader, whenever I see our motherland's production at a standstill, the economy in decline, I lament deep and deeper.
speaker: Witte
content: It grieves me so... Though I'm no military leader, whenever I see our motherland's production at a standstill, the economy in decline, I lament deep and deeper.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Did His Majesty pardon these opportunists? They'd put their own interest above His Majesty's and Ursus's with just one inch of slack, in one heartbeat.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Did His Majesty pardon these opportunists? They'd put their own interest above His Majesty's and Ursus's with just one inch of slack, in one heartbeat.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Don't condemn His Majesty's benevolence. Compared to putting up with a few shrewd but provisionally loyal nobles, what we truly cannot bear is continuing our endless internal friction.
speaker: Witte
content: Don't condemn His Majesty's benevolence. Compared to putting up with a few shrewd but provisionally loyal nobles, what we truly cannot bear is continuing our endless internal friction.

raw: [name="Witte"]  We must think of ways to pull out the weeds and pests. We must sow the seeds. We must, when spring comes again, see the new buds.
speaker: Witte
content: We must think of ways to pull out the weeds and pests. We must sow the seeds. We must, when spring comes again, see the new buds.

raw: [name="Witte"]  For this I've strived... please pardon my language; I very rarely say such things, but I swear upon His Majesty, I do feel pride in my own present status.
speaker: Witte
content: For this I've strived... please pardon my language; I very rarely say such things, but I swear upon His Majesty, I do feel pride in my own present status.

raw: [name="Witte"]  Old friend, be reassured. Those sacrificed cannot complete their undertaking. All those who survived will keep trying, and trying.
speaker: Witte
content: Old friend, be reassured. Those sacrificed cannot complete their undertaking. All those who survived will keep trying, and trying.

raw: [name="Witte"]  His Majesty will bring a new future to Ursus. Even the most stubborn nobles, and those twisted deities, and those monsters planted in the darkest corners of our motherland, they all must fear—they all must fear our Emperor.
speaker: Witte
content: His Majesty will bring a new future to Ursus. Even the most stubborn nobles, and those twisted deities, and those monsters planted in the darkest corners of our motherland, they all must fear—they all must fear our Emperor.

raw: [name="Witte"]  My duty is simply to ensure this.
speaker: Witte
content: My duty is simply to ensure this.

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Halt.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Did the head caretaker not tell you? Grand Duke Vanya has requisitioned this place, and no one is to come near.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Did the head caretaker not tell you? Grand Duke Vanya has requisitioned this place, and no one is to come near.

content: I'm the doctor on shift today. I'm the Grand Duke's medical consultant, by all rights. This is my work permit.

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: You're new here?

speaker: Lillia
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Grand Duke Vanya's doctor on duty is his private doctor. It's an unwritten rule. Lucky you, you pretty much get a vacation today.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Grand Duke Vanya's doctor on duty is his private doctor. It's an unwritten rule. Lucky you, you pretty much get a vacation today.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Seeing as it's your first time, I won't blame you. But wander around this corridor again, and your death will not be pretty.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Seeing as it's your first time, I won't blame you. But wander around this corridor again, and your death will not be pretty.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Now, get out. Find somewhere to spend your vacation while you have it.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Now, get out. Find somewhere to spend your vacation while you have it.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  It's me. Not much. The doctor on shift at the retreat. I'll get them out of here...
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: It's me. Not much. The doctor on shift at the retreat. I'll get them out of here...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: What...? The quack's vanished?

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  But it'd be dangerous to... erm... the Minister of Finance is here, I know...
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: But it'd be dangerous to... erm... the Minister of Finance is here, I know...

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: You two, halt.

speaker: Lillia
content: Yes, we're listening to you.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Can I ask if something's the matter?
speaker: Lillia
content: Can I ask if something's the matter?

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Come with me.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Listen. No matter what you find, it's because of the Grand Duke's same old problems. Don't make a fuss over nothing.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Listen. No matter what you find, it's because of the Grand Duke's same old problems. Don't make a fuss over nothing.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Be dependable. Take care of him properly. Get out quickly after the sun's down, and don't disturb his peace.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Be dependable. Take care of him properly. Get out quickly after the sun's down, and don't disturb his peace.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Treat him properly, and you'll be rewarded. Amply. Enough for... poor people like you to live happily for a long time.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Treat him properly, and you'll be rewarded. Amply. Enough for... poor people like you to live happily for a long time.

raw: [name="Lillia"]  Thank you kindly. We're honored to have this chance... Kal'tsit, where's your thanks?
speaker: Lillia
content: Thank you kindly. We're honored to have this chance... Kal'tsit, where's your thanks?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Ah... right. Thank you kindly, good sir.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Ah... right. Thank you kindly, good sir.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Hmph, country people. Don't mess this up.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Hmph, country people. Don't mess this up.

speaker: Lillia
content: We'll pay full attention.

speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Hold it.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  It's always been one person going in alone. We can't make an exception this time, or the Grand Duke will turn his rage on us.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: It's always been one person going in alone. We can't make an exception this time, or the Grand Duke will turn his rage on us.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Let this servant go in.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Let this servant go in.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Lillia
content: —But, sir, I'm the doctor here—

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  We prepare the medicine the Grand Duke takes. You just stay here and wait, and if anything happens, go in then.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: We prepare the medicine the Grand Duke takes. You just stay here and wait, and if anything happens, go in then.

speaker: Lillia
content: I don't understand—

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  I am saying to wait here for three hours, on standby.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: I am saying to wait here for three hours, on standby.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  And then, you. You cannot be in there for more than ten minutes.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: And then, you. You cannot be in there for more than ten minutes.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  If you take too long, no matter why, you will not leave alive.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: If you take too long, no matter why, you will not leave alive.

raw: [name="Ursus Officer"]  Search, and then let this servant go in first.
speaker: Ursus Officer
content: Search, and then let this servant go in first.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As you command.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Grand Duke.

raw: [Subtitle(text="With his back to the light sits an old man—lies an old man. He does not move, his breathing tranquil, gazing into the far distance.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: With his back to the light sits an old man—lies an old man. He does not move, his breathing tranquil, gazing into the far distance.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Is it the doctor?
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: Is it the doctor?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  No, I am only a servant.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No, I am only a servant.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Alright... come, come closer.
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: Alright... come, come closer.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As you command.

speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: Are you Ursus?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Lower your head. Let me feel your face.

content: Lower your head. Let me feel your face.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As you command.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Ah... Vulpo, or maybe Feline? An adorable race.

content: Ah... Vulpo, or maybe Feline? An adorable race.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Are... Are your eyes unsighted?

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Yes. A problem from last month.

content: Yes. A problem from last month.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  I'm due to die. Suppose it today, suppose it tomorrow. So you've come in vain, child.

content: I'm due to die. Suppose it today, suppose it tomorrow. So you've come in vain, child.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  They won't allow the doctor in—they're murdering me.

content: Exactly why. I am powerless to resist Ursus. I have since accepted that.

content: How is the weather today? I can feel the sunshine, turning warm now.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Not a cloud in sight, Grand Duke.

content: Not a cloud in sight, Grand Duke.

content: Ah... not a cloud in sight. It's been long. Since the last day like this.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Do you feel despair?

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Despair...? Despair is but a passer-by of the start. Our endless lives are always suffused with an emotion. It neither induces despair, nor makes your life bottomless joy.
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: Despair...? Despair is but a passer-by of the start. Our endless lives are always suffused with an emotion. It neither induces despair, nor makes your life bottomless joy.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  We are all living in compromise. Some would call it apathy, and some would say, I am simply reaping what I sowed.
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: We are all living in compromise. Some would call it apathy, and some would say, I am simply reaping what I sowed.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Yes. The weather is warming. That gust of wind just now failed to chill me to the bone.

content: Yes. The weather is warming. That gust of wind just now failed to chill me to the bone.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Who sent you, young lady?
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: Who sent you, young lady?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You've already surmised.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  And you are not astonished? Say, I thought a sum failure like myself would have been scapegoated in the limelight, forever looked down on by the young.
speaker: Grand Duke Vanya
content: And you are not astonished? Say, I thought a sum failure like myself would have been scapegoated in the limelight, forever looked down on by the young.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I have never looked down on a single person, let alone you, a Grand Duke of Ursus.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have never looked down on a single person, let alone you, a Grand Duke of Ursus.

raw: [name="Grand Duke Vanya"]  Of course you wouldn't tell me honestly... as to be expected. Let me take a guess...
